jobs.3dc068a81d8d: Colon (or semicolon) that ends an introducing clause and opens a list or explanation, e.g. 'the following components:', 'categories:'; also code-statement semicolons.
jobs.ea1c48f6a883: unclear: a content word or word piece (noun/adjective like ' approach', ' culture', ' safety', ' autism') in the middle of a noun phrase, expecting a continuation.
jobs.07e16941bffa: Preposition after a passive past participle or verb of placing/storing/publishing: 'stored on', 'published by', 'placed on', 'published in', 'played through'.
jobs.806be88936ec: Enumeration markers or ordinals: comma after 'First', ' place' in 'in the first place', numbered '1)' / '(ii)', or 'be/is' after 'first rule/reason'.
jobs.2c3982b314bc: unclear: boilerplate function word or newline in web-page furniture ('bottom of', 'Part of a series on', 'Main article:', '...more' newline, 'merged into', 'top left').
jobs.f44719d6e651: ' during' after a noun in 'during pregnancy/transmission'; also mid-word fragments of long rare words ('posttra|umatic', 'di|aphrag|m', 'incub|ation').
jobs.e56b6a078bd1: Short function word (by, of, with, had, for, were, to) right after a subject or past participle in the middle of a narrative or historical sentence.
jobs.c8f3e2d3e0c8: The digit '0' in a year starting '20' ('20⟦0⟧4'), where 20 precedes a year digit; weaker on 'Org' in PhysOrg and ' external'.
jobs.adcd3323e773: Preposition or determiner (' of', ' other', ' to', ' as') directly after a noun or verb, expecting a noun phrase next: 'version of', 'even other birds'.
jobs.80b8c1a2283a: German word suffix or inflection token inside a German name or phrase (-tes, -ches, -ues, -licher in 'Altes Stadthaus', 'Deutsches'); weaker on commas in citations.
jobs.d475d1937649: ' the' or short function word inside a fixed proper name or boilerplate phrase ('Center for Science in the Public Interest', 'Respect for the Integrity', 'There Will Be Blood').
jobs.b09f7584f42f: Opening parenthesis or quote, or a mid-name fragment, right after a name or term that is about to get an abbreviation or alias: 'Disorders (NORD)', 'the “Berlin Patient'.

jobs.1db833e02c95: Separator or URL/metadata token in web-page furniture: '?s', ' -', ' >', ' by', date comma, breadcrumb or byline punctuation.
jobs.c33e29d06ac3: Preposition or quantifier after a noun/verb in religious, legal or boilerplate prose ('after him', 'for reference', 'to dwell', 'all your heart', 'for judgment').
jobs.dc88eae2e52e: Comma, period or closing parenthesis right after a date/year/initial in a citation or dateline ('born October 16,', 'Whitaker J. S.,', 'CNS)'); year digits in lifespans.
jobs.ce4e3d093b14: Word-initial 'p'/'P' or 'imp' piece starting a word after a space or hyphen ('imp|airs', ' P|raise', '-p|ocking', '-p|ole').
jobs.3e8192271fba: Conjunction or preposition (' and', ' all', ' of', ' for', ' to') inside a title, heading or scripture quote, esp. capitalised 'Economics of Ecosystems and Biodiversity'.
jobs.0a5c00e9ef93: ' that' (also 'since', 'because', 'which', 'others') as relative pronoun or complementiser right after a noun/verb, opening a clause: 'the one thing that', 'realize that'.
jobs.7b93a689f0e9: Metadata/reference-line token after a name or place: given name, ' University', ' Press', ' on', day-of-week, comma or colon in bylines, citations, 'Published:' lines.
jobs.76d5c2771410: Opening quote mark ('“') or ' like' starting a quotation or saying after an attribution ('said:', 'once stated'); strongest on 'angle of reflection'.
jobs.cb6fce62d45c: ' following', ' this', ' below', ' blank' as determiner in instructions or question stems: 'Put the following', 'Does this test', 'each blank'.
jobs.9ca255257538: Word ending a list-introducing phrase before a colon or list: ' following', 'following words', ' systems', ' providers', ' information'; also commas ending clauses.
jobs.9076afbc39f9: ' as' after a subject or noun meaning 'in the role of' or 'in the capacity of' ('we as South Africans', 'you as bad guy', 'goals as teachers').
jobs.c06c6e7c5a64: First token (often 'As', 'Yes,', 'In', 'The') of the answer or body text right after a heading or question line; a comma after 'Yes'/'No'.
jobs.a9750af0d092: unclear: separator tokens (list '-', '3.', '||', ',', newline) in lists, tables and enumerations after an item.
jobs.e933a4eaca31: Newline or separator (|, 's, comma) following a heading, byline or dictionary title line; esp. newline after 'American Heritage Dictionary ... Fourth Edition'.
jobs.bd97e52bbc65: Single punctuation or digit piece inside codes and abbreviations: phone numbers (+41 22), 'L.)', '[Ar]', '(Beal)', 'B.C', '-flat', '2.3|0|9'.
jobs.9ac8abc05c0e: Word that follows an organisation or military/place name: ' National' in 'Los Alamos National', ' Space', 'Civil|ian'; also military and war-related word pieces.
jobs.655a52a55f24: ' on', ' forth' or ' etc' ending a trailing list ('and so on', 'etc.'); also last word of a list-closing noun phrase ('as well', 'and more').
